entities.name: Jorge Eduardo Eielson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jorge Eduardo Eielson was a Peruvian artist and writer. As an artist, he is known for his quipus, a reinterpretation of an ancient Andean device; they are considered precursors of conceptual art.
